findings.finding: Append-only history and deterministic projection are specified; implementation still needs an explicit policy for dangling links, cycles, forks and draft superseders.
findings.recommendation: Under existing ADJ-10/CHK-03 obligations, validate supersession graph integrity and reject or retain conflicting accepted heads; a draft link must not silently suppress accepted evidence. Define effective status as a projection without editing old bodies.

findings.finding: The old parser raises default exit1 on malformed JSON; the new plan explicitly requires exit3 for malformed required inputs. Copying that helper unchanged would violate CHK-04.
findings.recommendation: Keep old normalization behavior unchanged and implement/test the new parser/status contract in its own path, with valid multi-record siblings.

findings.finding: Connect/read bounds, two retries, redirects, URL/body/pass budgets are distinct quantities and differ from historical research limits.
findings.recommendation: Record initial attempt separately from up to two retries and name connect/read versus total elapsed limits in each pass. Local HTTP controls should exercise the actual read loop, redirects and exhaustion, not only mocked metadata. Preserve the earlier research manifests.

substantive_assessment.implementability: Finite queues, modular overlay, canonical deterministic projection and actual CLI controls form an implementable scope. Record validity deliberately permits unresolved external facts.
substantive_assessment.imports_and_originals: Research import and collector execution remain distinct; historical provenance/tool gaps are not backfilled. Replacement support cannot recover original citation/attachment identity.
substantive_assessment.identity: Organization, product/version, source code, deployment and fidelity are independent; proxy and build correspondence required; no brand or dependency inheritance.
substantive_assessment.adjudication: 18 explicit predicates cover all disputed labels plus challenge; support/refutation/silence/conflict/scope and process status remain distinct; partial or reviewed unresolved facets do not count as semantic closure.
substantive_assessment.evaluation: All75 current candidates/descendants and12 exposed proposals remain development. Honest empty manifest is not evaluation success; later complete synthetic reservation controls do not select actual new cases.
substantive_assessment.controls: Actual commands with passing siblings cover failure classes, missing/partial inventories, body/source/driver drift, unsafe outputs, deterministic rebuild and read-only mtimes. Production source facts require independent evidence review beyond validator success.
substantive_assessment.historical_evidence: c880 normalization controls are inherited with explicit dependency equivalence, not fresh5dc runs; current plan controls have not executed. The frozen research snapshot is not silently refreshed by concurrent new folders.
